chapter: The Original Dixieland band to California
title: Texas one-nighters and a brawl in Los Angeles
summary: The band played San Antonio and Austin, then a Huntington Park banquet ended when drunken pianist Scanley started a knife fight.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: You said when you got to Los Angeles, Ory had just left.
Ory had just left Los Angeles.

This happened after I... With this band, we went on to... We got together and rehearsed in Houston, and then got the music together good enough to play a little. It never was a good band to start with. But we played one-nighters; we played San Antonio, Texas, we played Austin or whatever...
Did you play for dancers with this band?

We played for some dancers. When we got to Los Angeles here, we had somebody booking these guys. They got us playing a banquet in Huntington Park, at an iron foundry; they was having some kind of big get-together. And this guy Scanley(?) was an alcoholic. And some guy says, "This guy Scanley(?) is all right, but you guys watch him. If he ever gets drunk, he's hell born over. He's a living devil." I said, "I can't believe Scanley..." He's such a nice guy sober!
And when we got to Los Angeles, they didn't have a piano, so there wasn't nothing for Scanley to play.
Oh, you mean they didn't have a physical piano anywhere.

So the guy said, 'Look, Scanley, you can stay here and clap you hands around the band,' and he said, 'I don't want you wandering off drinking anything.' So pretty soon we was playing and forgot about Scanley, and we played about an hour, and we heard all hell broke loose. Scanley had got drunk and had got in a big fight with this guy. Some guy almost killed a guy and pulled a knife, and they kicked us all out of this place. I don't think we got paid.
And from there on... We left Los Angeles and went up to San Francisco.
